tagline.en_US: Create and connect Markdown notes in a self-hosted, wiki-like workspace. The required SB_USER variable enables the initial single-user login, and /data holds the workspace.

description.en_US: SilverBullet is a browser-based personal knowledge database and note-taking system. It combines a live-preview Markdown editor with bidirectional wiki-style links, outlining tools, and task management. A built-in database with a query language and an integrated Lua scripting environment allows users to dynamically generate content, page templates, and custom widgets.
